rules: Ordinary creation and recovery screens use the prototype BACK action so the originating context is preserved.
The generating screen does not expose a clickable back action.
AI and manual creation success navigate to the matching draft confirmation screen for language, theme, device, and orientation.
Successful reconciliation of an unknown manual result navigates to draft confirmation; unresolved outcomes remain on the recovery screen.
AI service buttons remain unwired until a dedicated AI provider settings screen exists; they are not linked to general Settings.
